sources.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Applications in Python, Chapter 2
sources.authority: Official author-maintained site for the ISLP textbook.
sources.relevance: Chapter 2 supplies the statistical-learning foundations, assessment concepts, bias-variance trade-off, and KNN scope.
sources.evidence_used: Definitions and exercise patterns informed original bilingual identification, explanation, calculation, and diagnosis prompts.
sources.transfer_limits: The bank does not copy textbook exercises and has not yet received author or psychometric review.

sources.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Applications in Python, Chapter 3
sources.authority: Official author-maintained site for the ISLP textbook.
sources.relevance: Chapter 3 supplies linear regression, inference, diagnostics, interactions, qualitative predictors, and model-complexity concepts.
sources.evidence_used: The chapter's conceptual boundaries and small calculations informed original atomic prompts.
sources.transfer_limits: Concise text items do not test complete data-analysis workflows and remain pending expert review.

sources.title: Official Statistical Learning Online Courses
sources.authority: Official companion courses presented by the textbook authors.
sources.relevance: The course structure confirms introductory coverage and the separation of statistical-learning foundations from linear regression.
sources.evidence_used: Used to audit scope and prerequisite level, not to copy assessment content.
sources.transfer_limits: Course sequencing alone does not validate item difficulty or bilingual equivalence.

sources.title: ISLP Python Companion Documentation
sources.authority: Official companion documentation linked to the Python edition.
sources.relevance: Confirms practical coverage of regression, interactions, qualitative predictors, diagnostics, and KNN.
sources.evidence_used: Used to keep applied terminology compatible with the Python edition.
sources.transfer_limits: API examples were not treated as evidence of assessment quality; questions still need learner testing.
